content.text:
There's no diafiltration/membrane unit, no two-inlet membrane unit, and no Li/Co/Cl electrolyte property package among the available models (only mixers, splitters, separators, reactors, heaters, flashes, pumps, valves, feeds, and sinks).

The stream-level "state.n" specs are molar flows in a generic package, and the case needs a multi-component diafiltration unit with boundary-layer transport, which is not representable. I did not build a substitute.

```json
{"case_id": "blind_synthesized_prommis_nanofiltration_membrane_schematic", "status": "limitation", "revision_id": null, "job_id": null, "limitation": {"reasons": [{"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "MultiComponentDiafiltration"}, {"kind": "property_route_unavailable", "subject": "multi_component_diafiltration_solute"}], "explanation": "This OpenFlowsheet version lists only generic unit models: mixers, splitters, component separators, reactors, heaters, flashes, pumps, valves, feeds and sinks. None of them is a nanofiltration/diafiltration membrane unit with separate feed and diafiltrate inlets, retentate and permeate outlets, a membrane fixed charge and boundary-layer transport. A component separator or splitter would not do what the case's membrane unit does, so I built no substitute. The version also has no property route for the MultiComponentDiafiltrationSoluteParameter package, which is a Li/Co/Cl aqueous solute package with concentration-based states. The feed sources take only molar flows, T and P. No revision was committed and no solve was run."}, "claims": []}
```
